notes: Prism 2.9.4: Windows, level with the Mac. A new look and a new mark. The meeting card and the dictation pill are now islands, as on the Mac: one solid shape that grows, shrinks and moves between states in a single smooth motion, with clicks passing through the space around it. Deleted notes wait in Settings > Notes > Recently deleted for 30 days, with their transcript, recording and tasks, so you can bring them back. Choose your own dictation key: hold the key you want for three seconds. Notes open at once, on Prism notes. And Prism never deletes a note outright: if a file in it is in use, it waits and tries again. Free.
